title: Unstoppable Waveform!
flavor: Morphling kept accumulating his power in the dark journey for long. He controlled his elemental power with the tides of the ocean, capricious and unconstrained. Finally in the great war he entered the fight, shifted from form to form throughout the battle, instantly absorbing the ways of his enemies, until by the time the last soldier fell, Morphling had played every part. The battle's end was his beginning.

entries.name: Chessboards and UI optimization
entries.detail: Name panels and left pop-up panels removed. Couriers of both sides will broadcast the names and synergies.

entries.name: Morphling ($5/Element/Elf/Assassin)
entries.detail: Upgraded from $2 to $5, and gained Elf.

entries.name: Morphling - Waveform
entries.detail: Reworked <Passive Ability> Morphling will transfer his properties between his attack damage and health percentage due to his health status. The higher his health percentage is, the higher the attack speed he gains. <Active Ability: Activates on accumulated attack times> Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges towards an far-away enemy, dealing magical damage to enemy units on his path.

entries.name: Ogre Magi ($3/Ogre/Mage)
entries.detail: Upgraded from $1 to $3, Multicast reworked into an aura effect. <Aura>Grants all allies around: Have a chance to recast its ability and gain a bloodlust effect with bonus attack speed.
